---
name: agent-handoff
description: Prepare an evidence-based handoff for a completed or paused task.
---

Read `AGENTS.md`, `docs/coordination/PROJECT_STATUS.md`, `CURRENT_TASKS.md`, and the existing `AGENT_HANDOFF.md`. Record task completed, files modified, branch and commit hash (or explicitly uncommitted), exact tests/commands and results, technical decisions and approval state, known limitations, outstanding work, and recommended next action. Update the task status without claiming review or merge approval. Preserve existing unrelated work and keep the handoff concise and factual.
